A familiar voice.
A fresh start.

168’s moving and auto transport services were introduced across two separate websites. This combined experience brings them into one journey, from exploring your options to preparing an inquiry. Chinese-speaking support helps you ask the right questions and make your next move with a clearer plan.

  • One place for your vehicle and household needs
  • Clarify scope, costs and preparation before pickup
  • Plan your next chapter in a language you feel at home in

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Start with the essentials. We’ll help you work through the details.

Have another question? Let’s talk.
Can I arrange a car shipment and a household move together?+

Yes, you can inquire about both in one request. Provide your vehicle details, household inventory and both ZIP codes so the team can confirm transport methods, pickup arrangements and costs. Your vehicle and belongings may travel separately and arrive on different dates.

How is pricing calculated? Is the website price final?+

Pricing depends on the route, vehicle or shipment size, transport method, dates and additional services. This demo helps organize your inquiry; a team member must confirm the actual quote. Prices in historical case studies are not current offers.

Should I choose open or enclosed auto transport?+

Open transport can be considered for everyday vehicles. Enclosed transport provides a covered trailer and may suit special or high-value vehicles. Share dimensions, ground clearance and running condition so the team can assess suitable options and carrier requirements.

Can I leave luggage in my car?+

Confirm the item types, weight and placement with the team and carrier before booking. Weight allowances or free-item terms in older articles are not universal policies. Ask separately whether personal belongings are insured.

How long will delivery take? Can I choose the date?+

Pickup and delivery depend on the route, carrier schedule, weather, traffic and access. Share your availability and required arrival date for the team to assess options. Transit times in past cases are examples, not guarantees.

What should I know about inspection, insurance and payment?+

Document vehicle condition at pickup and delivery. Report any concerns promptly to the driver and support team. Before signing, confirm the carrier’s coverage, exclusions and claims process. Follow the agreed contract and verified payment instructions.
